content:
Headquarters:

We are looking for a Power Platform Solutions Architect for a global company. Their goal is to assess and modernize an existing Power Platform solution, define the target architecture, and lead the technical design of a scalable and secure implementation.

Required Skills:

  • Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages, and Power BI
  • Strong experience designing Dataverse schemas and security roles
  • Azure architecture experience with API Management, Azure Functions, Key Vault, Entra ID/SSO, and Azure Monitor/Application Insights
  • Experience designing enterprise integration architectures, including integrations where counterpart APIs or contracts are uncertain, changing, or being migrated
  • Experience integrating enterprise applications with ERP systems
  • Experience designing identity and access models for licensed and unlicensed user audiences
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Power Platform licensing models, including per-user Dataverse licensing and capacity/session-based Power Pages licensing
  • Experience evaluating existing solutions and defining modernization, remediation, or rebuild strategies

Optional Skills (not mandatory):

  • SAP integration experience

Deliverables

  • Lead the technical assessment of the existing Power Apps application, Power Automate flows, data layer, Power BI reporting, and four integration touchpoints
  • Support the Regulatory data-profiling spike and incorporate findings into the target solution architecture
  • Define and evaluate costed patch and rebuild options and support the final technical recommendation
  • Produce a detailed and staffed Phase 2 implementation plan
  • Design the consolidated Dataverse entity model and define workflow and business-logic architecture
  • Define the target integration architecture across the four integration touchpoints
  • Configure the Entra ID access model for licensed and unlicensed audiences
  • Configure the shared Azure API Management, Key Vault, and monitoring architecture supporting the integrations
  • Produce the technical handover documentation for the implemented solution
  • Engagement Highlights
  • Join a team of Toptalers already working for the client.
  • Lead the technical direction of a Power Platform modernization initiative from assessment through solution design
  • Own architecture decisions across Power Platform, Azure, identity, data, and enterprise integrations

General Information

Location: USA or Canada only.

Overlap: 6hs with the East Coast time zone, USATT

Commitment: Approximately 30 hours per week during Phase 1 and 10 hours per week during Phase 2.


To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-power-platform-solutions-architect
